items.headline: Dense Fog Advisory issued October 7 at 1:59AM PDT until October 7 at 9:00AM PDT by NWS San Francisco CA
items.description: * WHAT...Visibility 1/4 mile or less in dense fog.  * WHERE...San Francisco, Coastal North Bay Including Point Reyes National Seashore, San Francisco Peninsula Coast, Northern Monterey Bay, Southern Monterey Bay, and Northern Salinas Valley/Hollister Valley and Carmel Valley.  * WHEN...Until 9 AM PDT this morning.  * IMPACTS...Low visibility could make driving conditions hazardous.
items.instruction:
If driving, slow down, use your low-beam headlights, and leave plenty
of distance ahead of you.

If commuting, allow extra drive time to reach your destination
safely.
